title: Scored-path A/B: does CARNOT_ARC_STRUCTURED_NAV=1 improve the real E3AgentPolicy cascade on a navigation game (tu93)? Submission-gate evidence.
methodology_note: Same whole-loop scored cascade (run_bounded_progress -> E3AgentPolicy) as the Kaggle submission, same proposer/seed/budget; the ONLY change is CARNOT_ARC_STRUCTURED_NAV. tu93 = clean nav (decisive); ls20 = morph-win negative control (nav inducer should not help). Public-game frames for offline dev.
gate_evidence: GATE CLEARS: aggregate levels improved (or held) with nav gains and NO control/nav regression
headline: GATE CLEARS (broader 5-game scored A/B): total levels 0->1 (+1), NO regressions (nav or control). tu93 is a CLEAN win -- L0->L1 AND fewer actions (194 vs 214, more efficient). The other 2 nav-fire games are neutral (sk48 no plan installed on the cascade; wa30 installed a wrong plan at a NEGLIGIBLE +4-action cost, no level regression). Controls (ls20/sc25) unchanged. So the flag helps 1/3 tested nav games cleanly (level + efficiency), harms none.
submission_recommendation: The offline gate CLEARS per the arc3-online-gated-on-offline-beating-baselines discipline: a real offline improvement (+1 level, tu93 also more efficient) with no regressions. The flag is opt-in + non-breaking, and HEAD carries two independent fixes (the plan_in_model component-unpack regression 5841, and the false-negative heldout gate) that benefit any submission. THEREFORE a fresh scored submission with CARNOT_ARC_STRUCTURED_NAV=1 is now a DEFENSIBLE operator decision. HONEST CAVEATS: (1) the benefit is NARROW -- only tu93 among the tested public games cleanly benefits, so the hidden-set gain depends on the hidden games being clean-navigation-family like tu93 (unknown, unverifiable); (2) the level gain is modest (+1) and ~0.08 is generation-wall-bounded, so expect at most a small score change, not a step-change; (3) wa30 shows the flag CAN install a non-winning plan on an ambiguous nav game (bounded 4-action cost here). The evidence supports a submission; the upside is real but bounded; the downside is negligible. Operator-only decision (CLAUDE.md Operator-Only External Publication).
